setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A builder asks how a settlement larger than any Isolan village could dispose of refuse without poisoning its surroundings.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Researchers sketch channels that carry wastewater away, then ask where it ends up.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A healer points out that moving filth out of sight does not make it harmless.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A gardener proposes recovering useful materials while keeping dangerous waste away from crops.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A child asks who must do the unpleasant labor.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The group pictures polluted waterways and sick neighbors.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A council member asks whether prosperous districts might send their waste toward poorer ones.
